login.title: Log in
login.description: Log in with your username and password.

register.title: Create account
register.description: Create an account on the server. An internet connection is needed.

changePassword.title: Choose a new password
changePassword.description: This account has a temporary password. Before logging in, choose a new password that only you know.
changePassword.changed: Your password has been changed. From now on, log in with the new password.

hints.username: 3–32 characters: English letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore.
hints.password: At least 8 characters, with a digit, a lowercase and an uppercase letter.

validation.usernameFormat: Use 3–32 English letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore.
validation.passwordLength: The password must be at least 8 characters.
validation.passwordDigit: The password must contain at least one digit.
validation.passwordLower: The password must contain at least one lowercase letter (a-z).
validation.passwordUpper: The password must contain at least one uppercase letter (A-Z).

auth.signUpSuccess: Your account was created. You can log in now.

connection.offline: The server cannot be reached. You can log in with an account that has logged in on this computer before. Creating an account needs the server.
connection.unavailable: The server cannot be reached, and nobody has logged in on this computer yet. The first start always needs a connection to the server. Check the internet connection and try again.
connection.localDatabaseUnavailable: The server cannot be reached, and the clinic database on this computer is missing or damaged, so logging in without internet is not possible. Connect to the internet and try again.

errors.invalidInput: Some of the information entered is not valid.
errors.invalidInstallation: This installation is not recognised by the server.
errors.installationRevoked: This computer has been blocked. Contact support.
errors.notAMember: This account has no access to this clinic. Ask the clinic's administrator to add you.
errors.weakPassword: The password must be at least 8 characters, with a digit, a lowercase and an uppercase letter.
errors.serverUnreachable: Could not connect to the server. Check your internet connection.
errors.busy: The previous request is still in progress. Please wait a moment.
errors.invalidGrant: The saved login information is not valid. Log in once with an internet connection.
errors.clockTampered: The computer's date and time are wrong. Correct them and try again.
errors.offlineExpired: Offline access has expired. Connect to the internet to log in.
errors.offlineNotAvailable: The server cannot be reached, and this user has not logged in on this computer with an internet connection before.
errors.databaseUnavailable: The clinic database could not be opened. Log in once with an internet connection.
errors.noClinic: This computer was set up before clinics were registered and must be set up again. Contact support.
errors.passwordChangeRequired: This account has a temporary password that must be changed before logging in.
errors.subscriptionInactive: The clinic owner's subscription is not active. Contact support to renew it.
errors.clinicLimitExceeded: The clinic owner has more clinics than their subscription allows. Upgrade the subscription.
errors.deviceLimitExceeded: This clinic has more computers than its subscription allows. Upgrade the subscription or block another computer.
errors.passwordUnchanged: The new password must be different from the current one.

setup.title: Clinic setup
setup.notConnected: This computer is not connected to a clinic yet. Log in (or sign up first if you have no account), then choose or add your clinic. An internet connection is needed for this.

firstRun.title: Before you start
firstRun.onlyOne: Each computer is connected to exactly one clinic, and this choice cannot be changed later.
firstRun.backup: If you have a backup of the clinic's data, restore it from the Database page in the side menu after your first login. You will need that backup's password and recovery key.

pick.title: This computer's clinic
pick.description: {{name}}, choose the clinic this computer belongs to, or add a new clinic.

add.title: Add your clinic
add.noClinic: {{name}}, you do not own or manage any clinic yet. Add your clinic to use the app on this computer.
add.description: {{name}}, enter the new clinic's details. This computer will be connected to it, and you will be its owner.
add.submit: Register the clinic and log in
add.backToList: Back to the list of clinics

clinics.ownerOnly: Only this clinic's owner ({{owner}}) can connect a computer to it. Ask them to set up this computer.

subscription.none: You have no active subscription. The clinic will be registered, and after logging in you will go to the subscription page to buy one. The clinic opens once the subscription is active.
subscription.clinicLimit: Your subscription covers {{max}} clinics and you already have {{count}}. The new clinic will be registered, and after logging in you will go to the subscription page to upgrade.

hints.licenseNumber: In Latin letters and digits, as printed on the license.
hints.location: Click the clinic's place on the map. Zoom in with the mouse wheel.
hints.identityCode: A national ID or any other official code: 5 to 20 English letters or digits.
hints.existingIdentityCode: This account has no identification code on file yet; it is saved together with the clinic.

validation.licenseNumberFormat: Use 3 to 32 Latin letters, digits, dots, dashes or slashes.
validation.phoneFormat: The phone number must have 7 to 15 digits (optionally starting with +).
validation.postalCodeFormat: The postal code must have 5 to 10 digits.
validation.identityCodeFormat: The code must have 5 to 20 English letters or digits.
validation.locationRequired: Mark the clinic's place on the map.

errors.required: This computer is not connected to a clinic yet. Log in and choose its clinic.
errors.alreadyDone: This computer is already connected to a clinic.
errors.licenseNumberTaken: A clinic with this license number is already registered.
errors.identityRequired: This account has no identification code on file. Enter it.
errors.cityNotFound: This city was not found. Choose the province and city again.
errors.notClinicOwner: Only the clinic's owner can connect a computer to it.

billing.title: Subscription
billing.description: Your clinics' subscription, the plans and your payments. For now, payment is by card-to-card or bank transfer, and it becomes active once support approves it.

restricted.description: Until a subscription is active, only this page is available and the clinic data stays locked. Choose a plan and buy it; as soon as the subscription is active, the clinic opens by itself.

reasons.clinicLimitExceeded: You have more clinics than your subscription allows, and this clinic is not covered.
reasons.deviceLimitExceeded: This clinic has more computers than your subscription allows.

decided.approvedLogIn: The subscription was added. Log in again to use the clinic.
decided.noReason: No reason was given. Contact support.
decided.stillRestricted: The subscription is active, but it does not cover this clinic or this computer yet. The reason is shown at the top of the page.

plans.title: Plans
plans.description: Choose a plan to buy, renew or upgrade your subscription.
plans.pendingFirst: You have a payment waiting for approval. You cannot report another one until it is decided or you cancel it.
plans.none: No plans are for sale right now.

modes.extendHint: The new period starts when your paid time ends, at the full price.
modes.upgradeNowHint: The new plan starts on approval, and the value of the days left on your current subscription is deducted from the price.

purchase.title: Buy the {{plan}} plan
purchase.description: Transfer the amount to one of the accounts below, then report the transfer. The subscription becomes active once support approves it.
purchase.noAccounts: No account to transfer to has been set up. Contact support.
purchase.freeDescription: There is nothing to pay. Press Activate and the subscription becomes active right away, without approval.

hints.reference: The number the bank showed after the transfer (Latin letters and digits).

validation.accountRequired: Choose the account you transferred to.
validation.referenceFormat: The reference number must be 4 to 40 Latin letters, digits or dashes.
validation.cardLast4Format: Enter the last 4 digits of the card.

pending.title: Payment waiting for approval
pending.description: Support is checking the transfer. This page checks for the result every little while.

errors.ownerOnly: Only the clinic's owner can buy a subscription.
errors.needsServer: Managing the subscription needs an internet connection.
errors.subscriptionRequired: Until a subscription is active, only the subscription page is available.
errors.planInactive: This plan is no longer for sale.
errors.renewalQueued: You have already bought the next period, so upgrading now is not possible. Choose to upgrade after the current subscription.
errors.paymentAccountNotFound: This account no longer takes transfers. Choose another one.
errors.paymentPending: You have a payment waiting for approval. Wait for it or cancel it.
errors.paymentNotPending: This payment has already been decided.
errors.purchaseLimitReached: You cannot buy this plan again: you have used all the purchases it allows.
errors.paymentRequired: This purchase is not free. Transfer the amount and report the payment.
errors.paymentNotRequired: There is nothing to pay for this purchase. Use Activate instead.

details.checking: Checking whether the server can be reached.
details.offline: This computer is not connected to a network. The app works with the local database.
details.serverUnavailable: The network is connected, but the server is not responding. The app works with the local database and keeps retrying.

sync.upToDate: All changes are saved on the server.
sync.rejected: Records the server refused, waiting to be fixed: {{count}}
sync.financialLocal: Financial data is never synced and stays on this computer only.

update.description: You have version {{current}}. Installing closes and reopens the app, and you will need to log in again.
update.loggedOut: You were logged out to install the update.

required.title: Update required
required.description: This version of the app ({{current}}) can no longer be used. To continue, install version {{minimum}} or newer.
required.descriptionNoVersion: This version of the app ({{current}}) can no longer be used. To continue, install the new version.
required.offline: Connect to the internet to get the new version.
required.notFound: The new version is not on the server yet. Check again a little later.
required.dataSafe: The data on this computer is kept, and changes not sent yet are sent after the update.

errors.required: This version of the app can no longer be used. Update the app first.
errors.noUpdate: No update found to install. Check again.

errors.invalidIdentityCode: The identification code must have 5 to 20 English letters or digits.
errors.identityTaken: This identification code belongs to another account.
errors.identityMismatch: This identification code does not match the one on file for this account.

patients.title: Patients
patients.description: This clinic's patient records. Changes are saved on this computer first and synced whenever you are connected to the server.
patients.search: Search by name, identification code or phone

hints.identityCode: The patient's national ID or any other official code: 5 to 20 English letters or digits.
hints.medicalNotes: Conditions, allergies, medications and anything else important.

dialog.addDescription: If a patient with this identification code is already recorded, their details are updated.
dialog.editDescription: These details are shared by every clinic that treats this patient.

lookup.found: This patient's details were read from the server. Check them, then save.
lookup.foundLocal: This patient is already registered on this computer. Their details were filled in; saving updates the same record.

sync.waitingHint: Saved on this computer; sent once the server is reachable.
sync.rejectedHint: The server did not accept this record. Correct it and save it again.

history.title: Treatment history in every clinic
history.description: Read from the server and not stored here. Your view is recorded with your name and this clinic.
history.empty: No treatments recorded for this patient.

errors.nameRequired: Enter the patient's first and last name.
errors.invalidBirthDate: This date of birth is not valid.
errors.invalidPhone: The phone number must have 7 to 15 digits (optionally starting with +).
errors.tooLong: This text is too long. At most {{max}} characters are allowed.
errors.identityLocked: The identification code of a patient already saved on the server cannot be changed.
errors.identityTaken: A patient with this identification code already exists.
errors.historyNotFound: No clinic has a patient with this identification code.
errors.historyNeedsServer: Seeing a patient's history in other clinics needs a connection to the server.

treatments.title: Treatments
treatments.empty: No treatments recorded for this patient in this clinic yet.
treatments.performedByUnknown: A user who has not logged in here

hints.tooth: FDI tooth number, e.g. 36. Leave empty if the treatment is not about one tooth.

deleteDialog.title: Delete treatment
deleteDialog.description: “{{procedure}}” is removed from the patient's record, and the deletion reaches the server and the clinic's other computers too.

errors.invalidPerformer: Who performed the treatment is not valid.
errors.invalidDate: The treatment date is not valid.

trial.title: Your free trial is active
trial.description: The {{plan}} plan is active for free until {{date}}. After that, you can buy or upgrade a subscription on the Subscription page.

identity.hint: To make sure it's really you. After {{max}} wrong passwords you are logged out.

errors.wrongPassword: The account password is incorrect. Tries left before you are logged out: {{left}}
errors.unavailable: Your password can't be checked on this computer. Log out and log in again.
errors.tooManyAttempts: For security, you were logged out after {{max}} wrong passwords in a row. Log in again.

database.title: Database
database.description: Back up the clinic data on this computer, restore it from a backup, or clear it.

clear.title: Clear data
clear.summary: Permanently delete all clinic data on this computer.
clear.description: All clinic data on this computer is deleted, and then you are logged out. When you log in again, you are still the manager. Patient records saved on the server are downloaded again at the next sync, but financial data exists only on this computer and is deleted for good.
clear.warning: This cannot be undone. Without a backup, the deleted data is gone for good. If needed, make a backup first.
clear.loggedOut: The clinic data on this computer has been deleted and you have been logged out. Log in again to continue.

errors.notAllowed: Only the clinic's manager can back up, restore or clear the clinic data.

backup.secretsTitle: Don't lose the password and recovery key

hints.recoveryKey: 36 characters like XXXX-XXXX-…, as shown when the backup was made.

validation.recoveryKeyFormat: The recovery key must be 36 characters: digits and the letters A to F.

export.title: Make a backup
export.summary: Save an encrypted copy of the clinic data to a file.
export.description: An encrypted copy of all the clinic's data on this computer is saved to a file you choose.
export.warning: This backup is locked with two things: the password you choose here and a recovery key the app shows you after saving. Neither is stored in the app or on the server. Keep both somewhere safe yourself; without both of them, this backup can never be restored.
export.submit: Choose where to save and make the backup
export.doneDescription: "{{file}}" was saved. Keep the recovery key below, together with the password you chose, somewhere safe.
export.keepWarning: This key is shown only this once and is not stored anywhere. If you lose this key or the password, there is no way to restore this backup, and support cannot help either.
export.confirm: I have kept the key and password somewhere safe

restore.title: Restore from a backup
restore.summary: Merge a backup into the clinic data on this computer, or replace the data with it.
restore.description: Choose the backup file and enter its recovery key and password.
restore.warning: All the clinic's current data on this computer is replaced with the data in the backup. If needed, make a backup of the current data first.
restore.mergeInfo: The backup's data is added to the data on this computer and nothing is deleted. Where an item is both in the backup and on this computer, this computer's version is kept.
restore.success: The clinic's data was restored from the backup.
restore.successMerge: The backup has been merged into the clinic data on this computer.

errors.notABackup: This file is not a backup from this app, or it is damaged.
errors.invalidRecoveryKey: The recovery key was not entered correctly. Enter it again carefully.
errors.wrongSecrets: The password or recovery key is wrong, or the backup file is damaged.
errors.newerVersion: This backup was made with a newer version of the app. Update the app first.

languageManager.title: Languages
languageManager.description: Download more languages or remove the ones you don't need.
languageManager.activeCannotBeRemoved: The language in use cannot be removed. Switch to another language first.
languageManager.noneAvailable: No other languages are available right now.

errors.network: Could not connect to the server. Check your internet connection. ({{details}})
errors.languageNotFound: This language is no longer offered by the server.
errors.invalidLanguageFile: The downloaded language file is not valid. ({{details}})
errors.invalidLanguageCode: "{{code}}" is not a valid language code.
errors.fileSystem: Could not read or save the file. ({{details}})
